name: @compmd/host
description: The serving contract of a CompMD host over the Fetch API: a bundle's frames and the packs it or a store holds, with the headers that sandbox them, and a refusal saying why for anything else. For workers, Node and dev servers.
author: Hakan Serce

scripts.wasm: cargo build --locked --profile wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p compmd-host-wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/compmd_host_wasm.wasm && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('pkg/package.json', { force: true })"
